no_adcom_quote.quote: This application was not referred to an FDA advisory committee because it was clear that the applicant had provided substantial evidence of effectiveness from two adequate and well-controlled studies, using clinical trial designs similar to those of trials for previously approved migraine drugs. Moreover, the safety profile was deemed acceptable for the treatment of migraine, without controversial issues.

summary: No FDA advisory committee meeting was convened for AJOVY (fremanezumab, BLA761089). The Summary Review states the application was not referred to an advisory committee because the applicant had provided substantial evidence of effectiveness from two adequate and well-controlled trials with an acceptable safety profile and no controversial issues; the Medical Review likewise states no AC was held or planned. Because no committee met, there are no AdComm-driven linkages to any approval changes.
